sourceAttempts.result: Publishes a route-specific 150–1,000 cfs recommended band tied to the Verde River near Camp Verde gauge and rates the nine-mile run Class II to II.
USGS 09506000 Verde River near Camp Verde is the direct gauge named by the USFS guide and the RiverBrain route page; continuous data are available.
All six endpoints returned review within 155–181 feet of a topology-connected Verde River network; no suspicious, failure or unknown result remains.
Clear Creek is a popular RAP with a short steep carry below a diversion; private banks, shallow riffles, strainers, flash rises and the Wild and Scenic boundary remain explicit checks.
